causebase_summary: Alice Springs Child Centre Inc is recorded on the Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission (ACNC) register. The organisation’s ACNC Annual Information Statement for the year 01/07/2022 to 30/06/2023 was provided as the financial source. That report shows revenue of AUD 1,042,528 and total expenses of AUD 1,066,873 for the reporting year; the AIS entry is attributed as a direct subject report and not consolidated. The ACNC extract and the AIS are the only supplied sources; no website, program descriptions, stated beneficiaries or activities were provided in the supplied evidence. The record lists the organisation’s structured geography as Northern Territory. Other operational or programmatic details, including staff, volunteers, service types or locations within the Territory, are not available in the provided extracts.
